ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Predominantly low-intensity (black/dark grey) pixels across approximately 97% of the visible ventral surface, with high-intensity (white/beige) pixels concentrated at the distal tips and sparse linear marks.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Contiguous solid dark region across both lobes. Distinct, high-contrast irregular blobs are localized exclusively at the left and right distal margins; small, faint linear streaks of higher intensity are visible on the right lobe.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep V-shaped depression with an approximate 2D projection angle of 52 degrees and a vertical depth relative to lobe height of approx 0.25:1.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Generally smooth trailing boundary with low-amplitude micro-irregularities; the distal tips exhibit high-frequency, high-amplitude jagged protrusions caused by external clusters.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Trailing edge follows a broad convex curve from the median notch to the outer tips; leading edge shows a concave sweep toward the distal margins.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Dense clusters of circular/ovoid high-contrast pixel groups located at the extreme lateral edges (tips) of both fluke lobes, matching the profile of barnacle colonization.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Several thin, horizontally aligned linear pixel disruptions (white on black) are visible on the medial portion of the right lobe surface.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Extensive calcified clusters/encrustations creating significant texture and profile alteration at the distal tips of both lobes.
other_distinctive_markers: A pinniped (sea lion) head is visible at the water surface to the left of the peduncle.
